title: Cannabis industry predictions 2025: Policy
summary: The SAFE Act. Rescheduling. The Farm Bill. A new presidential administration. Nobody can predict the future of cannabis regulations — but we asked a few experts to try anyway. Marijuana Venture spoke with several entrepreneurs and operators in the cannabis space to get their predictions for 2025. Part 2 of this four-part series will cover cannabis policy.
body_markdown:
**Marijuana Venture -** 1/14/25


The SAFE Act. Rescheduling. The Farm Bill. A new presidential administration. Nobody can predict the future of cannabis regulations — but we asked a few experts to try anyway.


Marijuana Venture spoke with several entrepreneurs and operators in the cannabis space to get their predictions for 2025. Part 2 of this four-part series will cover cannabis policy.
